caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass stein with a lid. The main object is a large, transparent vessel with horizontal ridges circling its exterior body. The stein has a rounded, bulbous shape that gets slightly narrower at the base and the neck. Attached to the vessel on the right side is a single, curved handle that is also transparent and ends in a decorative downward curl at its base. The lid of the stein is domed with a prominent, twisted finial on top and fits snugly over the opening. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the use of graphite or pencil with some gray wash to indicate the glass's transparency and shading. In the upper right corner of the page, there is a smaller inset drawing that shows the same stein from a side profile, emphasizing the shape and handle placement. A small, horizontal scale bar is present in the lower left corner within the border of the main image. The background is plain and the objects are outlined with fine, clear lines.
title: Covered Mug
